# Vendored TypeNN browser runtime

Generated from [typeshade/typenn](https://github.com/typeshade/typenn) at commit `67480a1e1b89fd06b299c58be45df650c1c5dde4`.

Rebuild TypeNN, then run `npm run sync:typenn` from the website directory. The original Apache-2.0 license is included as `LICENSE`. The declaration file `index.d.ts` is maintained by the website for its narrow Playground import surface.
